name: veyra-kreaturenchronik
description: Veyra – eigenes Monster-Sammel-RPG als PWA / Capacitor-App

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init Veyra com.veyra.app --web-dir dist
scripts.cap:android: npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.build:staging: node build.mjs && node tools/make-staging.mjs dist build/staging && node tools/protect.mjs build/staging
